description: Extreme 5-day returns reverse due to liquidity provision and overreaction correction, particularly in large-cap stocks; falsified if the strategy's Sharpe ratio is not positive after 15 bps transaction costs, or if returns do not decay monotonically with holding period from 1 to 20 days.
